channel.title: Mizanora Platform — Blog
channel.description: Mizanora Platform — Muaaz Iqbal ke projects, blogs aur updates.

item.title: Kya Hua: GitHub Account Suspension — Poori Kahani
item.description: 2–3 saal ki mehnat, 90 repos — ek hi jhatke me 404. Kya hua, kyun hua, aur ab kya kar rahe hain.

item.title: Har Project Ka Backup: Zaroori Guide
item.description: Ek account suspend — saari mehnat gayab. Aisa na ho, isliye ye backup routine apnayein.

item.title: Platform v2 Live: Naya Mark, 10 Blogs, Dual Hosting
item.description: Mizanora Platform ka bara upgrade — official gold mark, generated covers, 5 naye blogs, auto sitemap aur Firebase Hosting + GitHub Pages dono par live.

item.title: Firebase Hosting + GitHub Pages: Ek Codebase, Do Ghar
item.description: Ek hi static codebase ko GitHub Pages aur Firebase Hosting dono par deploy karna — bilkul free, bina VPS, bina bill ka darr.

item.title: Noor AI: Urdu-First Assistant Kaise Sochta Hai
item.description: 'Sasta laal joota under 2k' — aisa messy Urdu sentence samajhna, keyword search se nahi hota. Noor AI ke design ke teen asool.

item.title: Mizanora Ecosystem: Her Project Ka Naqsha
item.description: Mizanora kya hai? Store, language, TV, AI, trading, Islamic tools — poora naqsha ek jagah.

item.title: IPTV Reseller Suite v6.1.2 — Owner Se Client Tak Ka Safar
item.description: 3-level economy: owner control → reseller workspace → client service. 183+ integration tests, signed playback, MAG/Stalker support.

item.title: Naye Developers Ke Liye 5 Sabaq — Saste Phone Se Shuru
item.description: Na laptop, na bootcamp, na English perfection — sirf ek sasta phone aur zabardast zid. Wo 5 sabaq jo 90 repos banane ke baad samajh aaye.

item.title: Muaaz Iqbal: Kasur Se Mizanora Tak
item.description: 2009 me paida hone wale ek larkay ne saste phone par duniya bhar ke platforms banaye. 'Unchi soch. Chhote qadam.'

item.title: Asaan Lang: Soch Urdu Mein, Code Roman-Urdu Mein
item.description: Pakistan ki apni programming language — 30 second me samjhein, phir khud likhein.
